name: SmartParallax
author: smartparallax

sections.description:
SmartParallax adds smooth, GPU-accelerated parallax motion to WordPress blocks and sections.
All effects are powered by pure CSS transforms and run fully on the GPU for stutter-free 120 fps animation.

The plugin works without JavaScript dependencies and integrates seamlessly into the Block Editor.

Highlights

  • 🚀 GPU-accelerated motion – powered by CSS transforms
  • 🎨 Controlled via simple CSS class names
  • 🧱 Works with all block themes and page builders
  • 📱 Fully responsive and accessibility-friendly
  • ⚙️ Zero-JS overhead – pure CSS magic

Available Classes

Class
Description

.parallax-image
Creates a moving background layer

.parallax-container
Moves an entire block or section

.parallax-x
Switches movement from vertical to horizontal

.parallax-(--)
Adjusts speed (e.g. .parallax-05 or .parallax--03)

.parallax-[…]-s
Stop-Sensitive Motion: stops when element leaves viewport center

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/smart-parallax/, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate SmartParallax through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add one of the provided CSS classes (like .parallax-image) to your block or container.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use JavaScript?

No, SmartParallax is 100% CSS-based. All animations are handled by the browser GPU.

Will it work with my page builder?

Yes. SmartParallax is fully compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks, and most theme builders.

Is it lightweight?

Absolutely. The total runtime footprint is under 10 KB, optimized for GPU transforms only.

1.0.2

  • Added: Original unminified CSS and JS files are now included in the release package for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Updated: Inline and blocks in admin pages migrated to wp_add_inline_script() / wp_add_inline_style().
  • Updated: Output buffering now uses ob_get_contents() + ob_end_clean() for proper closure during admin rendering.
  • Improved: Minor internal cleanup to satisfy WordPress.org review checks.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Text domain now matches plugin slug (smartparallax) for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Updated: Plugin URI now points to documentation page.
  • Minor cleanup before public release.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Includes base features: .parallax-image, .parallax-container, .parallax-x, .parallax-(--).
  • GPU-optimized motion with automatic background scaling.
